environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate task in a VPC private subnet (subnet-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) with route table rtb-0f9e8d7c6b5a43210 containing only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and no 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. No NAT Gateway, NAT Instance, VPC endpoint for S3/SSM, Transit Gateway attachment, or VPC peering connection with internet-routable paths exists in the VPC. The subnet's network ACL (acl-0112233445566aabb) has explicit DENY rules on all outbound traffic to destinations outside 10.0.0.0/16 (rule 50: DENY all protocols to 0.0.0.0/0, rule 40: ALLOW all protocols to 10.0.0.0/16). DNS resolution is provided by Route53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The ECS task security group (sg-0aabbccdd1122334) allows inbound only from sg-0ffee11223344556 (the internal ALB) on port 8080, and outbound only to 10.0.0.0/16 on all ports.
